jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Developer**  
**Position Overview**  
We are looking for a Senior Developer to join our Consulting business.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, build and deliver secure, scalable .Net applications, and Azure-based solutions for client projects, translating business requirements into effective technical outcomes.

You will also lead in stakeholder engagements and coordinate technical strategy in this space with team members.

This is a senior role where you will be given the platform to showcase your expertise and knowledge.

**Salary & Benefits**

The budgeted salary for this role is between **£70,000 to £80,000 a year**, depending on experience.

**Click here** for the list of benefits.

**Hybrid working**

We recognise the benefits that remote and flexible working brings.

We operate a hybrid working policy that allows our employees to balance time in the office and time from home. Each team within our organisation can decide how to implement this policy. If you have any questions after applying, please reach out to our recruitment team.  
  
**Responsibilities**  
Some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* **Designing, developing, and supporting** secure, scalable **.NET / Azure solutions**
* **Working with clients and stakeholders** to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* **Building and maintaining Azure PaaS services**, integrations, and APIs
* **Managing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code** using Azure DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, and/or Bicep
* **Producing technical documentation, estimates, and delivery artefacts** to support project outcomes
* **Collaborate within an agile team**, while mentoring others and contributing to continuous improvement

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Quickly add value** on a key client engagement, building strong relationships with senior stakeholders of varying technical backgrounds and helping shape strategic goals and outcomes.
* **Collaborate effectively** as part of an agile team, contributing to the design and delivery of **Azure solutions and architecture**.
* **Produce clear, high-quality** technical documentation, estimates, and implementation deliverables that align with project objectives and expectations.
* **Communicate confidently** in client-facing settings, translating business requirements into **secure, scalable, and effective technical solutions**.

**Qualifications & Experience**

The right candidate for this role will have:

* Strong **Microsoft .NET / C# development** expertise, delivering projects end-to-end
* Advanced **Azure DevOps and/or GitHub** skills, including **CI/CD pipelines / GitHub Actions**
* Proven experience with the **Microsoft Azure PaaS ecosystem**, including **Azure Functions, Storage, Logic Apps, APIs, managed identities, integration patterns, and secure Entra-based solutions**
* Experience with **infrastructure as code** using **Terraform and/or Bicep** for repeatable Azure deployments
* Strong **communication, documentation, estimation, and client-facing** skills, with experience working in **agile delivery environments**
* A collaborative team player who can **lead by example, mentor others, and guide delivery teams**

Please note, we may require you to obtain security clearance (SC) in the future, so for that reason we will ask you if you are a British passport holder with 5 years residency in the UK on the application form.

**About Us:**  
We are the tech company with people at heart.

At Advania, we believe in empowering people to create sustainable value through the clever use of technology. As one of Microsoft's leading partners in the UK, specialising in Azure, Security, Dynamics 365, and Microsoft 365, we have a proven track record of success in delivering transformational IT services.

**Our Selection Process:**

We are committed to ensuring an equitable experience for all candidates, regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Please do let us know if you’ll need any reasonable adjustments as part of the selection process by highlighting these on your application form.

As part of our commitment to our clients we will need to carry out background checks, including a criminal record check, for all offers of employment. If you have any unspent criminal convictions or questions about the screening process, please notify your recruiter once the application has been submitted.

**#LI-Hybrid**

jobs.title: Backend Developer dotNet AWS
jobs.description:
**Backend Developer dotNet and AWS**
------------------------------------

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

**Your role:**

We are looking for an experienced **Backend Developer with AWS** experience who enjoys taking ownership and driving work from idea to production. You are comfortable working in a complex environment, eager to understand the business and domain, and motivated by improving both the product and the way we work.

In this role you will play a key role in:

* Developing and modernizing backend services using **C# and .NET 10**
* Designing scalable, cloud-native solutions on **AWS**
* Building applications using **Entity Framework** and relational databases
* Contributing to **CI/CD pipelines**, deployment processes and engineering best practices
* Collaborating with business stakeholders, developers and architects in an international environment
* Taking ownership of solutions from requirements through implementation, deployment and support

**Your profile:**

* Strong hands-on experience with **C# and .NET**
* Experience with **Entity Framework** and relational databases
* Solid AWS knowledge and experience with cloud-based architectures
* Experience with **GitLab**, CI/CD practices and modern software delivery processes
* Good understanding of SOLID principles, clean code and Agile/Kanban ways of working
* Ability to independently drive development activities from requirements to production support

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with **Docker** and containerized applications
* Experience with **AWS CDK**, cloud-native development and cloud migration initiatives
* Experience owning and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines**
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**
* Experience modernizing legacy applications and architectures
* Experience with **WPF (.NET Framework 4.8)** and **CoreWCF/service-oriented architectures**

**What you will love about working here**

**Impact & Ownership:**Work on a strategically important platform used across multiple brands and countries within the TRATON Group, with the opportunity to influence technical direction and modernization initiatives.

**Modernization Journey:**Be part of the transformation from legacy technologies toward modern .NET, AWS, cloud-native architectures, and scalable integrations.

**Learning & Growth:**Expand your expertise across backend development, cloud technologies, architecture, integrations, and business-critical product configuration systems.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing:**Join a team that values collaboration, technical excellence, domain knowledge, and continuous improvement.

**International Environment:**Work closely with stakeholders, architects, and developers from different countries and business areas in a truly international setup.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

**Make it real**. | www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer for Marketing New
jobs.description:
Ghent, Belgium

  

**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**

We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

**Job Details**

* Marketing
* Belgium
* Full-Time/Hybrid

**What you will do**

You will join as a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer for Marketing**, focused on transforming our internal operations. You will be at the forefront of using AI to solve complex business problems, optimize workflows with AI agents, design and build integrations for business scalability. This is a future-proof role where you will build innovative solutions and have a direct impact on how our business operates as a key part of a new, decentralized team of AI specialists.

**Where you will have impact**

* Design and implement AI solutions that solve real-world business problems within our Marketing teams.
* Collaborate directly with domain experts to deeply understand business challenges, workflows, and opportunities for automation and improvement.
* Design, build, and operate AI agent workflows and integrations to optimize our marketing operations for scalability.
* Act as a key member of the broader cross-functional AI engineering team, sharing knowledge, best practices, and successful patterns.
* Work closely with our central AI infrastructure engineers to build robust and scalable solutions.
* Pitch your own ideas and co-create the roadmap for AI adoption within your domain, helping us build the perfect solutions.
* Drive projects with a solution-oriented and outcome-focused mindset, ensuring technology delivers tangible business value.

**About our team**

Lighthouse Marketing is a global team of creative thinkers who blend the art and science of marketing to amplify the brand, drive revenue, and deliver great marketing experiences. We work across time-zones, we focus on the metrics that matter, and we push each other to continually raise the bar. We embrace a customer-first approach to marketing and continually look for points of friction in the funnel that marketing can help to solve. We are on the lookout for new growth levers, we encourage experimentation, and we embrace a culture of learning and growth.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, and trainings to maximize your professional potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Mobility options: Mobility budget or company car (based on your job category).
* Net allowance: Support for home office related expenses.
* Vouchers: Lunch vouchers & Eco vouchers.
* Comprehensive health insurance: Extensive coverage for you and your dependents.
* Pension funding: Group insurance to secure your future.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* A strong background in Software Engineering and Integration Engineering.
* Hands-on experience experimenting with various AI tools and building out new, AI-driven workflows in production.
* Proven business understanding and experience working in a business-facing role.
* A solution-oriented and outcome-driven mindset, focused on solving problems rather than just pure engineering craftsmanship.
* A hands-on and curious nature, with an interest in learning and understanding complex business processes.
* Fluent communication in English.

### **We welcome**

* Familiarity with Marketing technology - Salesforce, Hubspot or similar tools.
* Experience building on top of LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) in a production context.
* Experience with data platforms such as BigQuery or similar.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

**Learn more about our careers and recruitment process** | **Our company and leadership team** | **Beware of recruitment scams**

We are looking for a talented **.NET Developer** to join a dynamic software development team responsible for building and enhancing a leading enterprise software platform used by professionals across Belgium.

You will play a key role in the design, development, and maintenance of modern web applications, working closely with technical leads and fellow developers in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain full-stack applications using modern Microsoft technologies
* Build scalable and high-quality software solutions
* Collaborate closely with technical leads and development team members
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions
* Work independently on assigned projects while also collaborating within the team
* Ensure high standards of quality, performance, and reliability
* Continuously learn and adopt new technologies and best practices

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong experience with **.NET 6/7/8** and **C#**
* Hands-on experience with **ASP.NET**
* Experience with **Angular**
* Strong front-end development skills using **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments
* Familiarity with **Git**, **Jira**, and **Confluence**
* Experience developing enterprise applications such as **CRM, DMS**, or similar business-critical systems
* Good knowledge of **SQL** and **Entity Framework**

Experience:

* Angular: 4 years (Required)
* Blazor: 3 years (Required)
* ASP.NET: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ghent
